label: 3D Resource Type
rdfs_comment: Description of the media format, denoted by an IRI.
skos_scopeNote: Values SHOULD be selected from the Controlled Vocabulary for Audiovisual Core digital3DResourceType http://rs.tdwg.org/ac/doc/3dtype/. In text-based systems such as tables, IRI values MUST be in unabbreviated form.
dcterms_description: Digital3DResourceType is distinct from file format as implied by the file extension.

label: 3D Resource Type (literal)
rdfs_comment: Description of the media format, denoted by a controlled value string.
skos_scopeNote: Values SHOULD be selected from the Controlled Vocabulary for Audiovisual Core digital3DResourceType http://rs.tdwg.org/ac/doc/3dtype/. It is best practice to use ac:digital3DResourceType instead of ac:digital3DResourceTypeLiteral whenever practical.

label: Color Boolean
rdfs_comment: Indicates whether each vertex with a unique x,y,z coordinate or polygonal face also has an associated color specified.
skos_scopeNote: Values SHOULD be selected from the TDWG Boolean Controlled Vocabulary http://rs.tdwg.org/tag/doc/boolean/. This term SHOULD be used when: (1) ac:digital3DResourceType is point cloud or polygonal mesh, (2) dc:format(s) is any of: pts, off, ply, obj, stl, glb, gltf, X3d, wrl, and (3) any ac:resourceCreationTechnique(s).

label: Face Count
rdfs_comment: Number of triangles or polygons with a unique set of three or more points as their vertices.
skos_scopeNote: This term SHOULD be used when: (1) ac:digital3DResourceType is a polygnal mesh, (2) dc:format(s) is any of: off, ply, obj, stl, glb, gltf, X3d, wrl, and (3) any ac:resourceCreationTechnique(s).

label: Normals Boolean
rdfs_comment: Indicates whether each vertex or polygonal face also has an associated normal vector specified.
skos_scopeNote: Values SHOULD be selected from the TDWG Boolean Controlled Vocabulary http://rs.tdwg.org/tag/doc/boolean/. This term SHOULD be used when: (1) ac:digital3DResourceType is point cloud or polygonal mesh, (2) dc:format(s) is any of: pts, off, ply, obj, stl, glb, gltf, X3d, wrl, and (3) any ac:resourceCreationTechnique(s).

label: Number of Images
rdfs_comment: The number of images or z-axis pixels that provide information on a 3D scene.
skos_scopeNote: This term SHALL be used to specify the number of files or slices in a projection series (CT), reconstructed image series (CT, MRI), or that were collected in a photogrammetry session. In cases where volume raster data is represented as a single file (Nifti, NRRD, 3D tiff, dicom Multi-files) it SHOULD be used to give the number of Z axis pixels. This term SHOULD be used when: (1) ac:digital3DResourceType is any of the following values: multi-file projection series, multi-file image slices series, single file image slice series, image collections, (2) dc:format(s) is any of: "raw", dcm, tiff, bmp, png, jpeg, nifti, nrrd, "zip", and (3) any ac:resourceCreationTechnique(s).
dcterms_description: Other possible uses include any case where each file in a collection represents a part or a view of a single or multiple focal objects that together can be used to understand the 3D nature of the focal object(s). For instance, raw data from laser scans and structured light scans often include a number of partial meshes that represent different parts of the scanned object which need to be processed through alignment and merging before rendering as a full 3D object.

label: Pixel X Spacing
rdfs_comment: The linear distance between each pixel in the X direction.
skos_scopeNote: For use describing 3D resources, this term MUST be used with ac:pixelYSpacing and ac:pixelZSpacing. An set of pixel spacing values MUST have a corresponding value for bf:Unit http://id.loc.gov/ontologies/bibframe/Unit.This term SHOULD be used when: (1) ac:digital3DResourceType is any of: multi-file projection series, multi-file image slice series, single file volume image, (2) dc:format(s) is any of: dcm, tiff, bmp, png, jpeg, nifti, nrrd, or raw or compressed formats, and (3) ac:resourceCreationTechnique is any of: CT, MRI, PET, SPECT, Neutron, Synchotron, Confocal Microscopy, Sonography, Image Stacking.

label: Pixel Y Spacing
rdfs_comment: The linear distance between each pixel in the Y direction.
skos_scopeNote: For use describing 3D resources, this term MUST be used with ac:pixelXSpacing and ac:pixelZSpacing. An set of pixel spacing values MUST have a corresponding value for bf:Unit http://id.loc.gov/ontologies/bibframe/Unit.This term SHOULD be used when: (1) ac:digital3DResourceType is any of: multi-file projection series, multi-file image slice series, single file volume image, (2) dc:format(s) is any of: dcm, tiff, bmp, png, jpeg, nifti, nrrd, or raw or compressed formats, and (3) ac:resourceCreationTechnique is any of: CT, MRI, PET, SPECT, Neutron, Synchotron, Confocal Microscopy, Sonography, Image Stacking.

label: Pixel Z Spacing
rdfs_comment: The linear distance between each pixel in the Z direction.
skos_scopeNote: For use describing 3D resources, this term MUST be used with ac:pixelXSpacing and ac:pixelYSpacing. An set of pixel spacing values MUST have a corresponding value for bf:Unit http://id.loc.gov/ontologies/bibframe/Unit.This term SHOULD be used when: (1) ac:digital3DResourceType is any of: multi-file projection series, multi-file image slice series, single file volume image, (2) dc:format(s) is any of: dcm, tiff, bmp, png, jpeg, nifti, nrrd, or raw or compressed formats, and (3) ac:resourceCreationTechnique is any of: CT, MRI, PET, SPECT, Neutron, Synchotron, Confocal Microscopy, Sonography, Image Stacking.

label: Point Count
rdfs_comment: Number of vertices with unique 3D X, Y, Z coordinates.
skos_scopeNote: This term SHOULD be used when: (1) ac:digital3DResourceType is point cloud or polygonal mesh, (2) dc:format(s) is any of: pts, off, ply, obj, stl, glb, gltf, X3d, wrl, and (3) any ac:resourceCreationTechnique(s).

label: Resource Creation Technique
rdfs_comment: Information about technical aspects of the creation and digitization process of the resource. This includes modification steps ("retouching") after the initial resource capture.
skos_scopeNote: In the case of 3D objects the modality SHOULD be specified using a controlled value string from the Audiovisual Core Modality Controlled Vocabulary http://rs.tdwg.org/ac/doc/modality/
dcterms_description: Annotating whether and how a resource has been modified or edited significantly in ways that are not immediately obvious to, or expected by, consumers is of special significance. Examples for images are: Removing a distracting twig from a picture, moving an object to a different surrounding, changing the color in parts of the image, or blurring the background of an image. Modifications that are standard practice and expected or obvious are not necessary to document; examples of such practices include changing resolution, cropping, minor sharpening or overall color correction, and clearly perceptible modifications (e.g., addition of arrows or labels, or the placement of multiple pictures into a table.) If it is only known that significant modifications were made, but no details are known, a general statement like "Media may have been manipulated to improve appearance" may be appropriate. See also Subject Preparation Technique.
examples: Encoding method or settings, numbers of channels, lighting, frames per second, data rate, interlaced or progressive, multiflash lighting, remote control, automatic interval exposure.

label: Texture Map Type
rdfs_comment: The kind of texture map associated with a point cloud or polygonal mesh resource, denoted by an IRI.
skos_scopeNote: In text-based systems such as tables, IRI values MUST be in unabbreviated form.
dcterms_description: Best practice is to use an IRI from a controlled vocabulary.

label: Texture Map Type (literal)
rdfs_comment: The kind of texture map associated with a point cloud or polygonal mesh resource, denoted by a controlled value string..
skos_scopeNote: It is best practice to use ac:textureMapType instead of ac:textureMapTypeLiteral whenever practical.
dcterms_description: Best practice is to use a string from a controlled vocabulary.

label: UV Coordinates Boolean
rdfs_comment: Indicates whether a mesh file has UV coordinates that map it to one or more materials or texture files.
skos_scopeNote: Values SHOULD be selected from the TDWG Boolean Controlled Vocabulary http://rs.tdwg.org/tag/doc/boolean/. Use this term in combination with these other AC terms, i.e., when: (1) ac:digital3DResourceType is point cloud or polygonal mesh, (2) dc:format(s) is any of: pts, off, ply, obj, stl, glb, gltf, X3d, wrl, and (3) any ac:resourceCreationTechnique(s).
